summary: Toppoint Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a private placement of 5,000,000 shares at $0.83/share for gross proceeds of $4,150,000. The price was set at the NYSE American minimum price. The transaction is expected to close on or around May 28, 2026. Proceeds are for general corporate and working capital purposes. This is a routine capital-raising event, not a special situation.
